profile.scope: HeapProfiler sampled allocation callsites during the profiled window; sampled bytes are estimates, not exact allocation totals or retained-memory evidence.
profile.recomputation: A bounded normalized CPU or sampled heap profile is retained with fixture paths sanitized so the profile summary can be independently recomputed.
profile.profileScope: Profile surrounds one actual createImportedGeometryLayer.loadAsync call and its bounded application conversion/publication hooks. It includes profiler control and any browser idle or garbage collection in the window; capture, geometry hashing, native picks and teardown occur after profiler stop. Sampled weights/bytes are diagnostic estimates, not exact costs or acceptance measurements.

unmatchedFlow.interpretation: observed-records-only; flow completion is not inferred; matches are scoped to one process, so cross-process links are not reconstructed

trace.caveat: Time overlap is correlational and does not establish that GC caused a slow load step. A profile window can include idle/control time. Instant GC markers are not pauses; unsupported or omitted trace events make this result incomplete.
